name: Music City Speedsolving Fall 2023
information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MusicCitySpeedsolvingFall2023#24123-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Join the [Cubing Southeast Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/491409969462797/) to hear about competitions in the Southeast before they're announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!
